description: This file defines functions for fetching and validating input parameters from different sources (GET, POST, REQUEST) in a PHP Web application, specifically for the TestLink project. It includes utility functions for processing string, integer, array, and checkbox inputs, along with sample usage comments and external class dependencies.

methods.name: P_PARAMS
methods.description: Fetches POST parameters specified by $paramInfo, optionally populating $args object.

methods.name: G_PARAMS
methods.description: Fetches GET parameters specified by $paramInfo, optionally populating $args object.

methods.name: R_PARAMS
methods.description: Fetches REQUEST parameters specified by $paramInfo, optionally populating $args object.

methods.name: GPR_PARAMS
methods.description: Fetches parameters from a specified source (GET, POST, REQUEST) for each item in $paramInfo, adds source info to each parameter's info array, and delegates to I_PARAMS.

methods.name: I_PARAMS
methods.description: Core function that processes $paramInfo array, retrieves parameters from sources, validates, normalizes, and returns the results; can populate $args object.

methods.name: GPR_PARAM_STRING_N
methods.description: Fetches and validates a string parameter with optional length, regexp, validation, and normalization callbacks.

methods.name: GPR_PARAM_INT
methods.description: Fetches and validates an integer parameter within optional min/max bounds with an optional validation callback.

methods.name: GPR_PARAM_INT_N
methods.description: Fetches and validates a non-negative integer parameter with an optional maximum value and validation callback.

methods.name: GPR_PARAM_ARRAY_INT
methods.description: Fetches an array of integer parameters with optional validation.

methods.name: GPR_PARAM_ARRAY_STRING_N
methods.description: Fetches an array of string parameters with optional validation.
